Instruction: blue sky, sunlit outdoor court, shadows and upper-right Just Breathe. are present; shorts remain large and centered, the setting lacks clear skate ramps, and yellow is an underline instead of an outline. Quality: clean typography and fabric, with slightly distorted small brand lettering.

Consistency: beaker shape, printed markings, placement and grey surroundings persist.
